content: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. It is important to avoid becoming pregnant while using dronabinol, as this medication may harm an unborn baby. Additionally, dronabinol passes into breast milk and may harm a nursing infant. Therefore, breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. Drug interactions can alter the way your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a detailed list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. Be sure to check the labels on all your medications, such as allergy or cough-and-cold products, as they may contain ingredients that cause drowsiness. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Do not share this medication with others. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time. Different brands of this medication may have different storage requirements. Check the product package for specific storage instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Dronabinol is used to treat nausea and vomiting caused by cancer chemotherapy, typically when other medications have not been effective. It is also used to treat appetite loss and weight loss in patients with HIV infection. Before starting dronabinol, read the patient information leaflet provided by your pharmacist. Take this medication by mouth as directed by your doctor. If you are using it to control nausea and vomiting, it is usually taken 4 to 6 times daily. If you are using it to treat appetite loss, it is typically taken twice daily, before lunch and dinner. The dosage is based on your medical condition and response to treatment. Do not increase your dose or use this medication more frequently or for longer than prescribed. If you suddenly stop using this medication, you may experience withdrawal symptoms such as irritability, trouble sleeping, restlessness, hot flashes, or diarrhea. To prevent withdrawal, your doctor may gradually lower your dose. Withdrawal is more likely if you have used dronabinol for a long time or in high doses. While this medication helps many people, it may sometimes cause addiction. The risk of addiction may be higher if you have a history of substance use disorder, such as overuse of or addiction to drugs or alcohol. Take this medication exactly as prescribed to reduce the risk of addiction. Common side effects of dronabinol include dizziness, drowsiness, confusion, feeling high, an exaggerated sense of well-being, lightheadedness, nausea, vomiting, or stomach/abdominal pain as your body adjusts to the medication. Remember that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they believe the benefit to you outweighs the risk of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Before taking dronabinol, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, marijuana (cannabis), or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients, such as sesame oil, which can cause allergic reactions or other problems. This medication may cause dizziness, drowsiness, or impair your judgment. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can worsen these effects. Avoid driving, using machinery, or performing tasks that require alertness until you can do so safely. Avoid alcoholic beverages.
